messages.subject: Maple Court - remedial action plan tracker (updated)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

Updated action-plan tracker attached. 11 of 13 actions complete, weighted completion ~94%. eMAR live, night nurse vacancy filled, external medicines audit done on 28 April with no outstanding concerns. The two open items are the safeguarding procedure refresh and the family reassurance forum, both in hand.

This should be the centrepiece of our representations on proportionality.

Lorna
